001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.LocationAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.StarSystemAPI;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.WeightedRandomPicker;
018
019public class GuideGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
020        
021        public static float GUIDE_GHOST_RADIUS_LY = 5f;
022        
023        
024        @Override
025        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
026                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
027                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
028                
029                WeightedRandomPicker<SectorEntityToken> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<SectorEntityToken>(manager.getRandom());
030                
031                LocationAPI hyper = Global.getSector().getHyperspace();
032                
033                for (SectorEntityToken curr : hyper.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.NEUTRINO_HIGH)) {
034                        if (curr.isPlayerFleet()) continue;
035                        float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(curr.getLocation(), pf.getLocationInHyperspace());
036                        if (distLY > GUIDE_GHOST_RADIUS_LY) continue;
037                        picker.add(curr, 1f);
038                }
039                
040                for (StarSystemAPI system : Global.getSector().getStarSystems()) {
041                        float distLY = Misc.getDistanceLY(system.getLocation(), pf.getLocationInHyperspace());
042                        if (distLY > GUIDE_GHOST_RADIUS_LY) continue;
043                        
044                        if (system.getDaysSinceLastPlayerVisit() < 90f) continue;
045                        
046                        float score = 0f;
047                        for (SectorEntityToken curr : system.getEntitiesWithTag(Tags.NEUTRINO_HIGH)) {
048                                if (curr.hasTag(Tags.OBJECTIVE)) continue;
049                                if (score == 0) score = 1f;
050                                score += score;
051                        }
052                        
053                        
054                        if (score > 0 && system.getHyperspaceAnchor() != null) {
055                                picker.add(system.getHyperspaceAnchor(), score);
056                        }
057                }
058                
059                for (SectorEntityToken item : new ArrayList<SectorEntityToken>(picker.getItems())) {
060                        if (Misc.crossesAnySlipstream(Global.getSector().getHyperspace(), 
061                                                                                  pf.getLocation(), item.getLocation())) {
062                                picker.remove(item);
063                        }
064                }
065                
066                
067                SectorEntityToken target = picker.pick();
068                if (target == null) return null;
069                
070                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
071                GuideGhost g = new GuideGhost(manager, target);
072                if (g.isCreationFailed()) return null;
073                result.add(g);
074                return result;
075        }
076
077        
078        @Override
079        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
080                return GhostFrequencies.getGuideFrequency(manager);
081                //return 10000f;
082        }
083        
084}
